title: Implement lead management system with data uploads and Stripe integration

requirements.text: Add bulk CSV/Excel file upload capability for importing leads into the system. The upload should validate required columns (name, contact, city, niche) and provide feedback on successful imports and any parsing errors.

quotes: Lead database with CSV/Excel bulk data upload capability

acceptanceCriteria: Users can upload CSV files containing lead data
Users can upload Excel files containing lead data
System validates that required columns (name, contact, city, niche) are present
System displays a summary of successfully imported leads
System displays errors for any leads that failed to import
Imported leads are stored in the backend and appear in the leads list

requirements.text: Enhance the existing lead dashboard with comprehensive search and filtering capabilities. Users should be able to search leads by name, filter by status and niche, and manage lead data through the interface.

quotes: Lead dashboard with search, filter, and management features

acceptanceCriteria: Search field filters leads by name in real-time
Status dropdown filters leads by their current status
Niche dropdown filters leads by service niche/category
Filtered results update dynamically as filters change
Users can view full lead details by clicking on a lead card
Users can edit lead information through the detail dialog

requirements.text: Integrate Stripe payment processing into the application. Users should be able to make payments for services, view payment history, and admins should be able to update payment status.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can initiate Stripe checkout for services
Payment orders are created and stored in the backend
Users can view their payment history on the settings page
Payment status is tracked (pending, paid, failed, refunded)
Admins can manually update payment status through the interface
Stripe payment method is available alongside existing UPI and Razorpay options

requirements.text: Create web forms for capturing new leads directly through the application. The form should collect essential lead information (name, contact, city, niche, status, revenue potential, owner) and save it to the backend.

quotes: Web forms for capturing new leads

acceptanceCriteria: Form includes fields for lead name, contact info, city, and niche
Form includes dropdown for lead status selection
Form includes field for revenue potential estimation
Form includes dropdown for assigning lead owner
Form validates required fields before submission
Successfully submitted leads appear in the leads list immediately
Form displays success message after lead creation
Form resets after successful submission

constraints: Use only Stripe for payment processing - do not implement Razorpay, WhatsApp, phone calls, LinkedIn, or Facebook integrations
Do not modify Internet Identity authentication hooks (useInternetIdentity.ts, useInternetIdentity.tsx)
Do not edit read-only UI component sources in frontend/src/components/ui
Maintain role-based access control (RBAC) throughout the implementation
Keep all Motoko logic in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo)
Preserve existing analytics features and dashboard functionality
nonGoals: AI automation service integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
External data export to third-party automation platforms
